requirements.requirement: The system must render a malpractice section within the provider scorecard UI when malpractice data is present.
The system must display a visual status indicator icon that reflects the malpractice status value (clean, flagged, or unknown).
The system must display the malpractice status label using neutral language consistent with prior labeling rules.
The system must render a clickable link to the state medical board when a valid state_board_url is provided.
The system must validate that the state_board_url is a properly formatted HTTPS URL before rendering it.
The system must not render the state board link if the URL is missing, malformed, or non-HTTPS.
The system must render the malpractice score contribution value in the section using the formatted output from display logic.
The system must render all malpractice section content through the MessageBubble.tsx markdown pipeline.
The system must sanitize all rendered markdown content to prevent script injection or unsafe HTML execution.
The system must ensure that outbound links rendered in the malpractice section open safely (e.g., no access to window.opener).
The system must display a fallback 'Information unavailable' state when malpractice data is null or missing.
The system must render the malpractice section without breaking the scorecard layout when optional fields (case_count, last_incident_date) are absent.
The system must ensure the malpractice section visually differentiates clean vs flagged states using distinct icons or styles.
The system must not display prohibited terms such as 'fraud' or 'misconduct' anywhere in the malpractice section.
The system must ensure that all text rendered in the malpractice section is derived only from the structured UI schema and not raw backend strings.
The system must render the malpractice section within 200ms after the parent scorecard component loads under normal conditions.
The system must ensure the malpractice section is accessible, including readable text labels for icons and keyboard-navigable links.
The system must prevent rendering of duplicate malpractice sections within a single provider scorecard.
